course_name_original: Ingénierie des connaissances et de la Décision

learning_outcomes.text: Structure a decision-making problem (actions, criteria, uncertainty) and adopt a resolution method (decision under uncertainty, multi-criteria).
Understand a knowledge engineering problem and envisage methods adapted to the context.
Understand the issues and challenges of decision-making under uncertainty and multi-criteria decision-making.
Know how to solve a decision-making problem by selecting appropriate criteria (depending on the context) and taking account of uncertainty and the multiplicity of criteria.
Understand the issues and challenges of knowledge engineering.
Have a panoramic view of the different approaches to knowledge engineering and their context of use.

syllabus_topics: Different decision contexts (games, operational research, social choice, under uncertainty)
Notion of decision criteria under uncertainty; study and criticism of different criteria (mathematical expectation, expected utility, MaxMin, criterion based on regrets, etc.)
Knowledge engineering issues (organisational learning, expert knowledge)
Knowledge engineering methods (documentary approach, formalisation of knowledge, feedback)
Scientific tools for knowledge engineering (use of the gprolog inference engine, use of a Case Based Reasoning tool)
assessment_rules: The evaluation formula is 1*DS1/1, indicating the grade is solely based on the final exam. No personal work is required outside of exam preparation.
bibliography: Ingénierie des connaissances, Régine Teulier, Jean Charlet, éditeur L'Harmattan, 2005
degree: Titre d'ingénieur ENIT (cycle ingénieur, semestres 5-10; orientación mecánica/producción)
